key_insight: TurtLES tests neural PDE surrogates on realistic 3D turbulent wakes, exposing rollout instability and loss of small-scale energy.
engineering_relevance: The benchmark helps assess whether AI surrogates can reliably accelerate turbulent-flow CFD at industrially relevant mesh resolutions.
method: Generate 3D cylinder wakes using high-fidelity implicit large-eddy simulations.
Vary geometry, Reynolds number, and angle of attack on dense irregular meshes.
Benchmark neural operators through autoregressive temporal rollouts.
evidence_signal: The 14 TB dataset contains 400 trajectories of 400 time steps each, with 3–11 million points per frame; evaluations identify temporal instability, small-scale energy loss, and difficulties with large irregular domains.
watch_item: The dataset's scale and irregular meshes may make storage, preprocessing, and model training computationally demanding.
paper_title: TurtLES: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Turbulent 3D Neural PDE Surrogates
